message.content: {"action":"decrease_table_capacity","reason":"Current LUT designs at depth 256 show a wide area/SQNR spread; reducing table depth is the only legal move that can lower mapped area while the existing linear-interpolation LUTs already provide strong SQNR at higher phase bits. This explores the area-saving direction without sacrificing the better numerical regime seen in the evaluated LUT points."}
